import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('va_geographic_distribution_of_expenditures_fy2023.xlsx', sheet_name='State Level Expenditures', header=None)
header_idx = df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.strip().str.startswith('State')].index[0]
df_data = df.iloc[header_idx + 1:].copy()
df_data.columns = [str(c).strip() for c in df.iloc[header_idx]]
state_col = [c for c in df_data.columns if 'State' in c][0]
pop_col = [c for c in df_data.columns if 'Veteran Population' in c][0]

df_states = df_data[df_data[state_col].notna()].copy()
df_states = df_states[~df_states[state_col].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower().isin(['totals', 'notes:'])]
df_states = df_states[pd.to_numeric(df_states[pop_col], errors='coerce').notna()]
df_states[pop_col] = pd.to_numeric(df_states[pop_col])

top3 = df_states.sort_values(by=pop_col, ascending=False).head(3)
result = top3[state_col].str.strip().tolist()

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('va_geographic_distribution_of_expenditures_fy2023.xlsx', sheet_name='CT', header=None)
header_idx = df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.contains('County', case=False, na=False)].index[0]
df.columns = [str(c).strip() for c in df.iloc[header_idx]]
df_data = df.iloc[header_idx + 1:].copy()
county_col = df_data.columns[0]
total_col = [c for c in df_data.columns if 'Total Expenditure' in c][0]

# Keep only county rows (before Totals / Congressional districts)
df_counties = df_data[df_data[county_col].notna()].copy()
end_idx = df_counties[df_counties[county_col].astype(str).str.contains('Totals|CONG', case=False, na=False)].index[0]
df_counties = df_counties.loc[:end_idx - 1]

# Total Expenditure is in $000s, so $100 million is 100,000
exp_numeric = pd.to_numeric(df_counties[total_col], errors='coerce')
result = int((exp_numeric > 100000).sum())

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('va_geographic_distribution_of_expenditures_fy2023.xlsx', sheet_name='HI', header=None)
header_idx = df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.contains('County', case=False, na=False)].index[0]
df.columns = [str(c).strip() for c in df.iloc[header_idx]]
df_data = df.iloc[header_idx + 1:].copy()
county_col = df_data.columns[0]
patients_col = [c for c in df_data.columns if 'Unique Patients' in c][0]

hawaii_row = df_data[df_data[county_col].astype(str).str.strip().str.upper() == 'HAWAII']
maui_row = df_data[df_data[county_col].astype(str).str.strip().str.upper() == 'MAUI']

hawaii_val = pd.to_numeric(hawaii_row[patients_col].values[0], errors='coerce')
maui_val = pd.to_numeric(maui_row[patients_col].values[0], errors='coerce')

result = hawaii_row[county_col].values[0] if hawaii_val > maui_val else maui_row[county_col].values[0]

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('va_geographic_distribution_of_expenditures_fy2023.xlsx', sheet_name='State Level Expenditures', header=None)
header_idx = df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.strip().str.startswith('State')].index[0]
df.columns = [str(c).strip() for c in df.iloc[header_idx]]
df_data = df.iloc[header_idx + 1:].copy()
state_col = [c for c in df_data.columns if 'State' in c][0]
patients_col = [c for c in df_data.columns if 'Unique Patients' in c][0]

fl_patients = pd.to_numeric(df_data[df_data[state_col].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Florida'][patients_col].values[0])
ca_patients = pd.to_numeric(df_data[df_data[state_col].astype(str).str.strip() == 'California'][patients_col].values[0])

result = 'yes' if fl_patients > ca_patients else 'no'

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('va_geographic_distribution_of_expenditures_fy2023.xlsx', sheet_name='AR', header=None)
header_idx = df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.contains('County', case=False, na=False)].index[0]
df.columns = [str(c).strip() for c in df.iloc[header_idx]]
df_data = df.iloc[header_idx + 1:].copy()
area_col = df_data.columns[0]
total_col = [c for c in df_data.columns if 'Total Expenditure' in c][0]

cd_rows = df_data[df_data[area_col].astype(str).str.contains('CONG. DIST', case=False, na=False)].copy()
cd_rows[total_col] = pd.to_numeric(cd_rows[total_col])
highest_cd = cd_rows.sort_values(by=total_col, ascending=False).iloc[0]
result = highest_cd[area_col].strip()
